entries: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5: now the default model in Claude Code, with a native 1M-token context window and promotional pricing of $2/$10 per Mtok through August 31. Update to version 2.1.197 for access. https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-sonnet-5

title.zh-TW: 預設模型升級成 Sonnet 5，記憶容量暴增到一百萬字，價格還打折
title.en: Default model upgraded to Sonnet 5 — memory jumps to a million words, and it's cheaper too

body.zh-TW: 你打開 Claude Code 現在預設用的就是 Sonnet 5，原生支援一百萬 token（AI 讀寫文字時切出來的最小單位，大約等於零點幾個字）的記憶視窗（context window，AI 一次能記住多少對話內容的容量），等於同一個對話能塞進更多的程式碼或文件還不會忘記前面講過什麼。即日起到 8 月 31 日，每百萬 token 只要 2 到 10 美元的促銷價。
body.en: Claude Code now defaults to Sonnet 5, with a native 1-million-token context window (context window, how much of the conversation the AI can remember at once; a token is the small chunk of text the AI reads and writes in) — meaning one conversation can now hold more code or documents without the AI forgetting what came before. From now through August 31, pricing is a promotional $2-$10 per million tokens.

items.original: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5: now the default model in Claude Code, with a native 1M-token context window and promotional pricing of $2/$10 per Mtok through August 31.

title.zh-TW: 對話裡的檔案附件可以直接點開，不用自己去資料夾裡翻
title.en: File attachments in chat are now clickable — no more digging through folders yourself

body.zh-TW: 以前 AI 在對話裡提到或附上一個檔案，你想看實體檔案在哪還得自己切到 Finder（macOS 的檔案總管）裡找。現在按住 Cmd（Mac）或 Ctrl（Windows/Linux）點一下附件，就會直接在檔案總管裡跳出來、選好給你看。像收到包裹不用自己去倉庫翻箱子，按一下貨單就直接帶你走到那一格架子前面。
body.en: When the AI mentions or attaches a file in chat, you used to have to switch to Finder or Explorer yourself and hunt for it. Now Cmd-click (Mac) or Ctrl-click (Windows/Linux) on the attachment jumps straight to that file, already selected, in your file manager. It's like a delivery slip that walks you straight to the right shelf instead of making you dig through the warehouse yourself.

items.original: Added clickable file attachments in chat — Cmd/Ctrl-click reveals the file in Finder/Explorer.

title.zh-TW: 查看 MCP 外掛清單不會再偷偷啟動陌生專案裡藏的伺服器
title.en: Listing MCP plugins no longer secretly starts servers hidden in untrusted projects

body.zh-TW: MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器以前只要你下 `claude mcp list` 或 `get` 這種「查清單」的指令，就算是還沒被你信任的專案，只要它的設定檔（.claude/settings.json）裡自己寫好「已核准」，也會被默默啟動執行。現在不會了：不信任的工作目錄會老實顯示「⏸ 等待核准」，光是查清單不會觸發任何程式執行。這就像你以前只是「看」陌生人的名片夾，結果名片自己跳出來打電話；現在光看不會打電話，要你親自按下確認才行。
body.en: MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets the AI talk to external tools) used to spin up just from running the read-only `claude mcp list`/`get` commands, even in a project you hadn't trusted yet, as long as its own settings file (.claude/settings.json) had self-approved itself. Not anymore — an untrusted workspace now honestly shows '⏸ Pending approval', and merely listing servers no longer triggers anything to run. It's like flipping through a stranger's business cards used to dial their number by itself; now looking doesn't dial — you have to press confirm yourself.

items.original: Security: `claude mcp list`/`get` no longer spawn `.mcp.json` servers that a repo self-approved via a committed `.claude/settings.json`; untrusted workspaces show `⏸ Pending approval`.

title.zh-TW: 喚醒背景工作不會再把整段對話紀錄誤刪、逼你重講一次
title.en: Waking a background job no longer wipes its entire conversation and forces a redo

body.zh-TW: 背景工作（background job，丟給 AI 在背後默默跑、你可以先去忙別的事的任務）以前偶爾會因為系統誤判對話紀錄檔案壞掉，喚醒時就把整段紀錄永久刪掉，還自動把你原本的指令重跑一次——等於白做工還搞丟記錄。現在系統改成「先把可疑檔案移到旁邊」，絕對不會直接刪除，你的對話紀錄保住了。像以前醫院弄丟病歷會直接燒掉重建檔案，現在改成先封存在另一個櫃子，至少東西還在。
body.en: Background jobs (tasks you hand off to the AI to run quietly while you do something else) used to occasionally have their entire conversation permanently deleted on waking, whenever the system misread the transcript as corrupted — and then it would auto-rerun your original prompt from scratch, wasting work and losing history. Now the suspect file just gets set aside instead of deleted, so your transcript survives. It's like a hospital that used to burn a medical record it thought was damaged and start a new one from scratch; now it just files the old one in another drawer instead — at least it's still there.

items.original: Fixed waking a background job permanently deleting its conversation and re-running the original prompt when the transcript probe misread a real transcript; the file is now set aside, never deleted.

title.zh-TW: 開「跳過所有權限確認」模式時，現在會老實告訴你風險，不會默默改成別的模式
title.en: The "skip all permission checks" flag now honestly warns you of the risk instead of quietly switching modes

body.zh-TW: `--dangerously-skip-permissions`（危險跳過權限確認，讓 AI 不問你同意就直接執行所有動作的開關）這個參數以前有個 bug：你明明開了它，系統卻偷偷把它降級成「自動模式」（auto mode，仍會在風險動作前問你），子代理（被主任務分派出去做事的小 AI 助手）也沒真的套用跳過權限的設定，而且不會跳出風險警告告訴你發生了什麼。現在修好了：你開這個開關，系統就老實顯示風險聲明、子代理也會確實套用同樣的跳過權限設定。這就像你按下「跳過安檢」的按鈕，警衛卻偷偷還是把你攔下來檢查、也不告訴你為什麼——現在按下去就真的跳過，而且會先提醒你「這樣做有風險喔」。
body.en: `--dangerously-skip-permissions` (a flag that lets the AI act without asking your permission first) had a bug: turning it on used to silently downgrade it to 'auto mode' instead (which still asks before risky actions), without showing the risk disclaimer, and subagents (helper AIs spawned to do part of the work) didn't actually inherit the bypass either. Now it's fixed — flipping the switch shows the real risk warning, and subagents genuinely inherit the same bypass. It's like pressing a 'skip security check' button that secretly still stopped and searched you anyway, without telling you why — now pressing it really does skip the check, after first warning you it's risky.

items.original: Fixed `claude agents --dangerously-skip-permissions` silently falling back to auto mode instead of showing the bypass disclaimer and applying bypass mode to spawned agents.

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查指令變更省，同樣品質但少燒四分之一額度
title.en: Code review got leaner — same quality, a quarter less quota burned

body.zh-TW: `/code-review`（叫 AI 幫你審查程式碼找問題的指令）背後原本拆成五個各自獨立的「抓問題小幫手」分別跑一輪，現在合併成一個一起跑，審查品質不變，但消耗的 token（AI 讀寫文字計費的最小單位，你的用量額度就是用這個算的）少了大約四分之一。這就像原本派五個保全分頭巡邏五次，現在改成一個熟練的保全一次巡完全部範圍，一樣巡得到、但人事費省了四分之一。
body.en: `/code-review` (the command that has the AI review your code for problems) used to run five separate 'issue-finder' passes behind the scenes. Now they're merged into one pass — same review quality, but token usage (token, the unit the AI's reading/writing is metered in, which is also what your usage quota counts) drops by roughly a quarter. It's like replacing five separate security guards each patrolling once with one experienced guard who covers the whole route in a single pass — same coverage, a quarter less payroll.

items.original: Improved `/code-review` workflow: merged five cleanup finders into one, cutting token usage by roughly 25%.

title.zh-TW: 在終端機模式打指令時，檔案路徑會即時跳出來讓你選，不用自己一個字一個字拼
title.en: Typing commands in terminal mode now auto-suggests file paths as you go, no more spelling them out yourself

body.zh-TW: 在 Claude Code 裡按 `!` 切換到 bash 模式（直接打終端機指令、不經過 AI 對話的模式）打字時，現在輸入檔案路徑會即時跳出自動完成（autocomplete，打到一半就幫你列出可能的選項讓你選）建議清單，不用自己記清楚資料夾名稱再一個字一個字打對。就像你在搜尋引擎打字，還沒打完它就先幫你列出你可能要找的東西。
body.en: When you press `!` in Claude Code to drop into bash mode (typing raw terminal commands directly, bypassing the AI), typing a file path now triggers live autocomplete (autocomplete, a suggestion list that pops up partway through typing) — no need to remember and spell out exact folder names yourself. It's like a search engine that starts suggesting what you're looking for before you've finished typing.

items.original: Added live file path autocomplete to bash mode (`!`).

title.zh-TW: `/clear` 清空對話後，`/rewind` 現在可以把清空前的內容拉回來
title.en: After `/clear` wipes the conversation, `/rewind` can now bring back what came before it

body.zh-TW: `/clear`（清空目前對話、讓 AI 忘記前面講過什麼的指令）以前一旦按下去，前面的對話就真的回不去了。現在 `/rewind`（倒帶，把對話拉回之前某個時間點的指令）支援連 `/clear` 之前的內容都能拉回來，等於多了一次反悔的機會。像你以前按下碎紙機就真的沒救了，現在碎紙機旁多了一台還原機，可以把紙條重新拼回去。
body.en: Once you ran `/clear` (the command that wipes the current conversation so the AI forgets everything before it), there used to be no going back. Now `/rewind` (the command that rolls the conversation back to an earlier point) can reach back to before a `/clear`, giving you a second chance. It's like a paper shredder that used to be final — now there's a reconstruction machine next to it that can piece the strips back together.

items.original: Added `/rewind` support for resuming a conversation from before `/clear` was run.

title.zh-TW: 從任務面板停掉的背景代理人，這次是真的停了，不會自己又活過來
title.en: Stopping a background agent from the tasks panel now actually stays stopped — no more resurrections

body.zh-TW: 背景代理人（background agent，被分派出去獨立工作的子 AI）以前你在任務面板按下「停止」，結果它過一陣子又自己悄悄醒過來繼續跑，等於你的停止指令沒被真正遵守。現在修好了：按下停止就是永久停止，不會詐屍。就像你以前拔掉吸塵器插頭，它過幾分鐘又自己插回去運轉；現在拔掉就是真的關機。
body.en: Background agents (helper AIs spawned to work independently) used to occasionally wake themselves back up and keep running a while after you'd hit 'stop' in the tasks panel — your stop command wasn't really being honored. Now it's fixed: stopping an agent is permanent, no resurrections. It's like a vacuum cleaner that used to plug itself back in and start running again a few minutes after you unplugged it; now unplugging it actually means it stays off.

items.original: Fixed background agents resurrecting after being stopped — stopping an agent from the tasks panel is now permanent.

title.zh-TW: AI 一個字一個字吐出回答時，現在不會再把你的電腦風扇逼到狂轉
title.en: While the AI streams its answer word by word, your computer's fan no longer has to work overtime

body.zh-TW: AI 用串流（streaming，AI 一邊想一邊把文字逐字吐出來、不用等全部想完才顯示的方式）方式輸出回答時，系統以前是每收到一點新文字就立刻重新畫一次畫面，很耗電腦資源。現在改成把文字更新合併、每 100 毫秒（千分之一秒）統一刷新一次，CPU（處理器，電腦的大腦，負責執行運算）使用量降低了大約三分之一強。這就像以前服務生每端一口菜就跑一趟廚房，現在改成湊滿一輪菜再一起端出來，跑的趟數少了，人也不會那麼喘。
body.en: When the AI streams its answer (streaming, writing text out token by token instead of waiting until it's fully done), the system used to redraw the screen every single time a little new text arrived, which was hard on your machine. Now text updates are batched and redrawn once every 100 milliseconds (a thousandth of a second), cutting CPU usage (CPU, your computer's 'brain' that does the actual computing) by roughly a third. It's like a waiter who used to run to the kitchen for every single bite of food, now waiting to carry out a full round of dishes at once — fewer trips, less out of breath.

items.original: Reduced CPU usage during streaming responses by ~37% by coalescing text updates to 100ms.

entries: Added support for organization default models — admins set it in the org console; it shows as "Org default" (or "Role default") in `/model` when you haven't picked one yourself
Added readable default names for sessions at start, making them easier to identify and message
Added clickable file attachments in chat — Cmd/Ctrl-click reveals the file in Finder/Explorer
Security: `claude mcp list`/`get` no longer spawn `.mcp.json` servers that a repo self-approved via a committed `.claude/settings.json`; untrusted workspaces show `⏸ Pending approval`
Fixed waking a background job permanently deleting its conversation and re-running the original prompt when the transcript probe misread a real transcript; the file is now set aside, never deleted
Fixed the rate-limit warning flickering off and rate-limit telemetry being over-counted when multiple parallel requests were in flight at the moment a usage limit was hit
Fixed duplicate recap lines after a background session's turn: a schema-rejected StructuredOutput attempt no longer renders alongside its retry
Fixed PowerShell `git diff`/`git grep`, `egrep`/`fgrep`, and quoted search patterns containing `|` being reported as failures when they exit 1, matching Bash behavior

Fixed multiple `claude agents` side panel issues: keyboard focus getting stuck when opening an agent, background jobs losing their subagent types on every open, and sessions showing incorrect status while actively running
Fixed `claude agents --dangerously-skip-permissions` silently falling back to auto mode instead of showing the bypass disclaimer and applying bypass mode to spawned agents
Fixed mid-turn crash recovery for Remote sessions — sessions interrupted by a server restart now auto-resume on the next worker
Fixed sessions moved with `/cd` reappearing in the old directory's resume list after a non-graceful exit when the old path contained special characters
Fixed `claude plugin validate` skipping local plugins whose source is "." and stopping after the first error class
Fixed Esc Esc at an idle prompt not opening the rewind menu (regression); use Ctrl+C or Ctrl+X Ctrl+K to stop background agents
Fixed MCP OAuth requesting the authorization server's full `scopes_supported` catalog when no scope is specified, causing `invalid_scope` failures on GitLab self-hosted and other enterprise IdPs
Fixed `/context` showing 0 tokens for all tool groups on Bedrock
Fixed `/deep-research` misreporting verifier failures as "all claims refuted" instead of `unverified`
Fixed plugin dependency version pins not being honored when the marketplace was added as a local folder path backed by a git repo

Fixed `claude agents` session status: completed rows no longer flip between "Done" and "Needs your input", stalled agents are now labeled "Needs attention", and results that mention a PR show a clickable link
Fixed voice dictation swallowing spaces and spuriously starting a recording during very fast typing when voice mode is enabled

Improved background session reliability: long-running commands and workflows now survive the session's process being stopped, restarted, or updated — including on Windows, where background shells are handed off instead of being killed
Improved background agents: workers killed by a daemon restart are now automatically resumed from where they left off the next time the agents view opens
Improved `/code-review` workflow: merged five cleanup finders into one, cutting token usage by roughly 25%
Reduced per-frame rendering work in the terminal UI by skipping no-op subtree walks during streaming
The streaming idle watchdog is now on by default for all providers — it aborts and retries when a response stream produces no events for 5 minutes. Set `CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG=0` to disable.
Remote Control is now disabled when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at a non-Anthropic host, matching the existing behavior under `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK`/`_VERTEX`/`_FOUNDRY`
Changed opening the agents view from a foreground session to require a single `←` press instead of two, matching the behavior in background sessions

title.zh-TW: 組織專屬模型設定、任務預設有名稱，團隊協作更順暢
title.en: Organization default models, named sessions, easier collaboration

body.zh-TW: 如果你在企業團隊中使用 Claude，現在管理員可以統一設定大家預設要用哪個模型（例如 Opus 或 Sonnet）了，當你沒特別選的時候，選單裡會顯示「組織預設」。為了讓你在一堆背景任務中不迷路，現在你一開啟新任務，系統就會自動幫它取個好讀的名字，方便你隨時找它或傳訊息給它。此外，當 Claude 在對話裡提到某個檔案時，你現在可以直接按住 Cmd 鍵並點擊那個檔案名稱，你的電腦就會自動打開對應的資料夾把檔案指給你看。這就像去圖書館，以前櫃檯只給你一堆亂碼編號叫你自己找書，現在不只每本書都有清楚的書名，你還能點一下書單上的名字，管理員就直接把書送到你面前。
body.en: If you use Claude in an enterprise team, admins can now configure a default AI model (like Opus or Sonnet) for the whole company; if you haven't picked one, your menu will simply show "Org default". To help you avoid getting lost in a sea of background tasks, the system now automatically assigns readable names to new sessions as soon as they start, making them much easier to identify and message. Also, when Claude mentions a file in the chat, you can now simply Cmd-click (or Ctrl-click) it to instantly reveal that file in your Finder or Explorer. It's like going to a library where the clerk used to just hand you a list of barcode numbers; now, every book has a clear title, and simply pointing at a title on the list magically summons the book right to your hands.

title.zh-TW: 背景任務大升級：程式關閉或更新，任務依然活著
title.en: Background tasks survive app closes and updates

body.zh-TW: 背景任務現在有了「不死之身」。以前如果你把 Claude 關掉、重新啟動，或是程式剛好在背景自動更新，你那些跑到一半的長時間指令和任務就會全部慘死；現在它們能在這些劇烈變動中存活下來，甚至在 Windows 上也不例外。如果不小心發生系統重啟導致背景任務死掉，下次你打開清單時，它們會自動從上次斷掉的地方無縫接軌繼續做。這也順便解決了以前你喚醒一個卡住的任務時，系統可能會誤刪掉它整份對話紀錄並強迫重頭開始的毛病。這就像你在煮湯時家裡突然停電，以前整鍋湯會壞掉只能倒掉重煮，現在復電後瓦斯爐會自己點火，繼續把你那鍋湯熬完。
body.en: Background tasks are practically immortal now. Previously, if you closed Claude, restarted it, or if the app updated itself in the background, your long-running commands and workflows would instantly die; they now survive these severe disruptions and carry on, even on Windows. If a system restart does manage to kill a background worker, the next time you open the agent list, it will automatically resume exactly from where it left off. This also fixes a nasty bug where waking a stalled task could accidentally delete its entire conversation history and force it to restart from scratch. It's like cooking a slow stew when the house loses power: previously you had to throw out the ruined pot and start over, but now when the power returns, the stove turns itself back on and flawlessly finishes simmering your meal.

title.zh-TW: 效能與防呆優化：不再誤報錯誤、節省 25% 資源
title.en: Performance and foolproof: no false errors, saves 25% tokens on code review

body.zh-TW: 跑 `/code-review` 時現在約省 25% token，長時間無回應也會自動重試。如果你使用 `/code-review` 讓 AI 幫你做程式碼審查，系統現在把五個找問題的步驟整合成一個，幫你省下大約 25% 的 token 額度（使用量）。防呆方面，當你輸入速度太快時，語音系統不會再自作主張偷偷幫你啟動錄音並吃掉你的空白鍵；如果 AI 回應的訊號卡住超過 5 分鐘都沒反應，系統會自動把它切斷重試，不會讓你枯等。針對安全，如果有人透過設定檔偷偷塞了一個假的 MCP（外部工具）伺服器，現在系統會強制標示「等待批准」，不會直接給它過關。而在 Windows 的 PowerShell 用 `git diff` 這類指令時，也不會再因為一些正常的輸出被系統大驚小怪當作執行失敗了。這就像請人幫你看合約，以前他會分五次跟你收費，現在一次看完而且打七五折；而且遇到來路不明的夾帶文件，他也會立刻幫你攔下來檢查。
body.en: Running `/code-review` now saves roughly 25% of tokens, and stalled responses will auto-retry. The `/code-review` command has been streamlined: five separate cleanup steps are now merged into one, cutting your token usage (API costs) by roughly 25%. On the foolproof side, typing very fast will no longer accidentally trigger the voice dictation system or swallow your spaces; and if an AI response completely stalls for 5 minutes with no output, a new watchdog will automatically abort and retry instead of leaving you staring at a frozen screen. Security got a bump too: malicious MCP (external tool) servers trying to sneak in via project settings files are now firmly blocked with a "Pending approval" badge. Also, using commands like `git diff` in Windows PowerShell will no longer falsely trigger catastrophic error alarms just because of standard text output. It's like hiring a lawyer to review a contract: they used to charge you for five separate meetings, but now they do it all at once for a 25% discount, and they instantly red-flag any sketchy clauses slipped in by the other party.

items.original:
Improved `/code-review` workflow: merged five cleanup finders into one, cutting token usage by roughly 25%
Security: `claude mcp list`/`get` no longer spawn `.mcp.json` servers that a repo self-approved via a committed `.claude/settings.json`; untrusted workspaces show `⏸ Pending approval`

title.zh-TW: 遠端任務自動復活，指令與權限錯誤修復
title.en: Remote crash recovery and permission command fixes

body.zh-TW: 現在對於遠端控制（Remote session）有了更強的防呆保護。如果遇到伺服器重新啟動中斷了連線，任務現在懂得在下一個工作節點上自動接續復活，不會直接暴斃。當你用 `/cd` 換資料夾並遇到程式非正常關閉時，如果舊路徑有特殊字元，也不會再發生舊路徑像幽靈一樣一直卡在復原清單裡的毛病。在權限控制方面，當你使用 `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 這個危險參數時，系統現在會乖乖顯示免責聲明並套用跳過模式，不會再一聲不響地退回一般自動模式騙你。此外，原本在沒事做的時候按兩下 Esc 打不開時光倒流（rewind）選單的退化問題修好了；而從一般視窗要打開代理人面板時，現在也只要按一次左鍵就好，跟背景任務的行為統一，不用再傻傻連按兩次。
body.en: Remote sessions just got a major resilience upgrade. If a mid-turn server restart interrupts your Remote session connection, it will now gracefully auto-resume on the next available worker instead of dying abruptly. If you moved directories with `/cd` and the app crashed, your old path won't haunt the resume list forever just because it had special characters in its name. On the permissions side, using the hazardous `--dangerously-skip-permissions` flag now actually displays the bypass disclaimer and applies the bypass to spawned agents as promised, instead of silently falling back to regular auto mode. Additionally, the regression where pressing Esc twice at an idle prompt failed to open the rewind menu is fixed, and opening the agents view from a foreground session now requires just a single left arrow press instead of two, matching the background session experience.

Fixed sessions moved with `/cd` reappearing in the old directory's resume list after a non-graceful exit when the old path contained special characters
Fixed `claude agents --dangerously-skip-permissions` silently falling back to auto mode instead of showing the bypass disclaimer and applying bypass mode to spawned agents
Fixed Esc Esc at an idle prompt not opening the rewind menu (regression); use Ctrl+C or Ctrl+X Ctrl+K to stop background agents
Changed opening the agents view from a foreground session to require a single `←` press instead of two, matching the behavior in background sessions

title.zh-TW: 減少無用耗能與閃爍，外掛與登入驗證更順利
title.en: Reduced UI stuttering and smooth sailing for plugins and logins

body.zh-TW: 終端機畫面的運作變得更省力了。在生成長回答（streaming）時，系統現在懂得跳過沒變動的區塊，不再浪費資源重繪整個畫面；在背景任務執行結構化輸出失敗時，也不會再把失敗的那行跟重試的那行重複印出來閃瞎你的眼。同時，它也修復了幾個常讓你誤會的狀態顯示，像是在 Bedrock 平台上 `/context` 不會再全部顯示 0 個 token，深研（`/deep-research`）功能在驗證失敗時也會老實顯示「未驗證」，而不是誇張地跟你說「所有聲明都被反駁」。此外，如果你把 外部套件（plugin）放在自己電腦上或用 Git 管理，系統以前可能會跳過檢查或忽視你鎖定的版本號，甚至在 MCP 驗證時因為要求過多權限（scopes）而導致在 GitLab 登入失敗，現在這些驗證流程與權限要求都精準修復了。最後，如果你手動把底層服務器設定為非 Anthropic 的主機，系統也會自動把你不需要的遠端控制功能關掉，免得浪費連線。就像開車把儀表板上亂跳的油表修好，還把冷氣效率調高；去辦通行證時，警衛也不會因為你資料放錯夾子就拒絕你，一切通關都變得順暢無阻。
body.en: The terminal interface has been optimized to save energy and reduce visual clutter. When streaming long responses, the UI now skips redrawing unchanged areas to cut down on rendering work. If a background agent's structured output fails validation, it will no longer confusingly print the rejected attempt right next to its retry. We've also fixed several misleading statuses: `/context` will no longer falsely show 0 tokens across the board on Bedrock, and the `/deep-research` tool will accurately report "unverified" instead of dramatically claiming "all claims refuted" when a verification fails. For plugins and integrations, validating local plugins from the "." path now works properly, dependency version pins are respected even in git-backed local folders, and MCP OAuth logins will no longer ask for an entire encyclopedia of scopes causing enterprise IdPs like GitLab to outright reject you. Finally, if you configure a custom non-Anthropic base URL, the app now automatically disables the unneeded Remote Control feature to match other Bedrock/Vertex environments. It's like fixing a twitchy fuel gauge and upgrading the AC efficiency in your car; and when you go to get your security badge, the guard no longer rejects you just because you asked for building access in the wrong format.

title.en: Voice dictation upgrades: catches silence, auto-submits CJK languages

body.zh-TW: 用語音講話來輸入指令變得更聰明了。以前對於不使用空格的語言（像是日文、中文、泰文），你講完話系統常常不知道你講完了、不會幫你自動送出；現在它終於學會聽懂這些語言的停頓並自動幫你送出了。在 macOS 上，如果你跑了很久的任務中間切換了麥克風設備，以前它會變成錄不到聲音的瞎子，現在修好這個毛病了；而在 Linux 系統上，它也能精準分辨出你到底是「沒有麥克風／錄音裝置」還是「缺少 SoX（一個音訊處理工具）」，不再丟出籠統的錯誤。這就像一個終於學會聽外語的打字員，以前你講中文他不知道你哪句是結尾，現在他能精準抓到你的句點並幫你交卷，而且麥克風插頭被踢掉他也會立刻發現。
body.en: Dictating commands with your voice is now much smarter. Previously, for languages that are written without spaces (like Japanese, Chinese, or Thai), the system struggled to realize when you finished speaking and would fail to auto-submit your message; it now perfectly understands the pauses and submits them automatically. On macOS, if you swapped your microphone device in the middle of a long-running session, the app used to go deaf and just record pure silence; that's fixed. On Linux, it can now clearly distinguish whether you are entirely missing a microphone or just missing the required audio software, giving you exact error messages instead of vague ones. It's like a typist who finally learned a foreign language: they used to never know when your Chinese sentence ended, but now they punctuate and submit it perfectly, and they'll instantly notify you if your microphone cord gets unplugged.

title.en: Mouse tweaks, plugin and background task fixes

body.zh-TW: 這次針對操作與背景工具修好了一些讓人煩躁的細節。如果你不想在全螢幕時不小心點到畫面，現在你可以設定（`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS`）把滑鼠點擊和拖曳的功能關掉，但保留滾輪滑動的方便性。設定外掛（plugin）時，如果外掛的名稱帶有連字號（像 `code-reviewer`），以前系統會因為名字太像而抓錯人，現在會精準比對全名；就算外掛在商城的名字跟它內部寫的名字不一樣，你也能正常把它關掉或打開。另外，如果你用新版 Claude 啟動了背景任務，清單不會再因為看不懂就把它變不見；當掉的任務重新打開時也不會再讓你呆看 5 秒的全白畫面了。這就像微調你的辦公桌，滑鼠現在可以只准捲動不准點擊防誤觸，而且請來的外包人員（外掛）不會因為名字拼錯一個字就賴帳不工作，你的工作清單也不會因為軟體升級就神祕消失。
body.en: Several frustrating details surrounding controls and background tools have been ironed out. If you hate accidentally clicking things in fullscreen mode, you can now toggle a setting (`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS`) to completely disable clicks, drags, and hovers while still keeping the convenience of the scroll wheel. For plugins, if a tool's name contained a hyphen (like `code-reviewer`), the system used to lazily match parts of the name and load the wrong thing; it now strictly matches exact names. You can also successfully toggle a plugin on or off even if its internal code name differs from its storefront name. Furthermore, background jobs written by a newer version of Claude will no longer mysteriously vanish from your agent list, and if you reopen a crashed task, it instantly restarts instead of forcing you to stare at a blank white screen for 5 seconds. It's like customizing your workspace: your mouse can be locked to scrolling only so you never click by accident, your hired contractors (plugins) won't refuse to work just because of a typo in their name, and your to-do list won't magically erase itself just because you bought a newer pen.

body.zh-TW: 這次讓自動模式（auto mode）跟背景任務變得更聰明。現在自動模式拒絕你執行的動作時，會把「為什麼拒絕」的理由清楚寫在紀錄與權限面板裡；你也可以開啟新設定，讓所有指令都經過安全分類，而不只是針對特定程式碼。對於背景代理人，它現在學會了平行處理，不會再笨笨地為了啟動代理人而要求主對話中斷。系統也新增了自動記憶體清理機制（memory-pressure reaping），會把閒置的背景指令清掉以節省資源。此外，以前你切換到背景時，常會被假警報恐嚇說「任務會被放棄」，或是莫名其妙生出一個重複執行對話的幽靈任務；在更新過後，這些假警報、幽靈任務，以及代理人面板會把其他兄弟代理人藏起來的毛病，全都修好了。就像請了一個精明的管家，以前他拒絕你做事只會搖頭，而且每次分派任務就要你閉嘴等他；現在他會清楚告訴你原因，並且能一邊聽你說話一邊指揮傭人，還會自動把沒在用的房間燈關掉省電。
body.en: Auto mode and background tasks just got a lot smarter. When auto mode denies an action, it now explicitly lists the reason in the transcript and permissions panel; you can also opt to route all terminal commands through the safety classifier instead of just specific code-execution patterns. For background agents, launching one no longer instructs the main AI to "end your response"—it can keep working on other things while the agent runs in parallel. We also added an automatic memory-pressure reaping system that sweeps up idle background shells to save resources. Moreover, several annoying bugs are squashed: sending tasks to the background no longer spooks you with false "tasks would be abandoned" warnings, nor does it spawn a phantom subagent that re-runs your entire conversation, and the agent panel won't erroneously hide sibling agents anymore. It's like hiring a savvy butler: previously, he just shook his head without explaining why you couldn't do something, and told you to stop talking while he dispatched chores; now he explains his logic, listens to you while delegating tasks, and remembers to turn off the lights in empty rooms to save power.

body.zh-TW: 跟外部系統打交道變得更順暢了。現在你在終端機使用 bash 模式（打 `!` 開頭）時，系統會即時幫你自動補齊檔案路徑，不用再辛苦地一個字一個字打。如果你的 MCP（外部工具伺服器）需要登入認證，系統一啟動就會溫馨提示你去 `/mcp` 處理；而且當工具呼叫因為權限不足（401/403 錯誤）被擋下時，MCP 輔助程式現在會自動重新連線並重試，不會直接死給你看。此外，當外部套件（plugin）在市集上改名時，你的設定檔也會自動跟著更新名字。登入後查看模型選單時，也不會再看到過期或空白的假畫面了。就像你的專屬助理，現在打字會自動幫你接下去，去別的部門調資料遇到門禁會自己想辦法重新刷卡，別人改名了也懂得幫你更新通訊錄，而且名片本打開永遠是最新狀態。

If your MCP (external tool server) requires authentication, the app now clearly notifies you at startup to check `/mcp`; and if a tool call gets rejected with an auth error (401/403), the helper will now automatically reconnect and retry instead of immediately failing. Additionally, if a marketplace plugin changes its name, your settings will automatically update to follow suit. The `/model` menu and other data-gated UI elements will also no longer show stale or empty states right after you log in. It's like having a smart assistant who finishes your sentences, automatically swiping their badge again if the security door doesn't open the first time, keeping your address book updated when contacts change their names, and ensuring your rolodex is always perfectly current.

title.zh-TW: 時光倒流更強大，畫面捲動不再亂跳
title.en: Rewind got stronger, and scrolling stopped jumping

body.zh-TW: 對話歷程的掌控度變得更高了。現在就算你已經用 `/clear` 清空了畫面，你還是可以用 `/rewind`（時光倒流）功能，回到清空之前的對話狀態，不用擔心手滑按錯。閱讀長篇對答時，以前只要 AI 還在吐字（streaming），畫面就會失控一直被強迫拉到最底，害你看不到前面的內容；或是當你在代理人名單捲動超過上限時，整個面板會詭異地跳動一行，現在這些惱人的畫面干擾都修好了。這就像看網路直播，以前只要有人一直洗留言，你的畫面就會被強制往下拉；現在你可以安心往上滑看舊留言，畫面穩如泰山。
body.en: You now have tighter control over your conversation history. Even if you've wiped your screen with `/clear`, you can still use `/rewind` to resurrect the conversation from exactly where it was before the wipe, saving you from accidental clicks. When reading long answers, the app used to forcefully yank your scrollbar to the bottom while the AI was still streaming new words, making it impossible to read earlier text; similarly, scrolling past the overflow cap in the agent roster would cause the whole panel to jump weirdly. These annoying visual interruptions are now fixed. It's like watching a live video stream where the chat used to violently auto-scroll whenever someone posted a new message; now you can peacefully scroll up to read older comments while the chat stays perfectly anchored.

items.original:
Added `/rewind` support for resuming a conversation from before `/clear` was run
Fixed scroll position jumping to the bottom while reading earlier output during a streaming response
Fixed the agent panel jumping by one row when scrolling the roster past the overflow cap

title.zh-TW: 徹底終止背景任務，介面操作更友善
title.en: Kill background tasks permanently, friendlier UI interactions

body.zh-TW: 從任務面板停掉背景代理後，它不會再自己復活。以前你從任務面板停掉一個背景代理人，它過不久又會像殭屍一樣復活，現在停掉就是永久終止了。如果你在代理人面板（`claude agents`）貼上圖片，它現在會乖乖顯示 `[Image #N]` 佔位符，不再把整串又臭又長的路徑印出來佔版面；如果你對著背景任務輸入 `/usage` 這類內建指令，它現在會提示你正確用法，而不是笨笨地把指令當成聊天文字傳出去。其他修復還包含：登入網址在 Windows 終端機跨行時不會再被截斷、解決了特定環境（Ghostty）下全螢幕無法點擊連結的問題、修正用逗號分隔的掛鉤（hooks）條件會默默失效的 Bug、開場動畫不再超出 Mac 終端機預設大小、組織禁用 `/voice` 語音時會給出明確原因，而且在「最近拒絕」的權限面板裡點擊同意，關閉後設定終於會確實保留了。這就像把辦公室裡各種不順手的工具都換新：原本打死不退的離職員工被徹底請走，超長的公文附件會幫你自動縮排整理，印表機出錯也會告訴你到底哪裡卡紙，一切都變得俐落直覺。
body.en: Stopping a background agent from the tasks panel will now prevent it from resurrecting. Previously, stopping a background agent from the tasks panel would see it resurrect like a zombie shortly after; now, stopping an agent permanently terminates it. If you paste an image into the `claude agents` panel, it will politely display a `[Image #N]` placeholder instead of littering the screen with the full, obnoxiously long file path; and if you type a builtin slash command like `/usage` to a background session, it now shows a helpful hint instead of blindly sending it as chat text. Other fixes include: login URLs no longer truncate when wrapping across lines in Windows Terminal, fullscreen Cmd-click links now work in Ghostty, comma-separated hook matchers no longer silently fail, the splash art won't overflow the default macOS Terminal window, disabled `/voice` modes now properly explain organizational restrictions, and approving a permission in the 'Recently-denied' tab finally saves properly upon closing. It's like replacing all the clunky tools in your office: the ex-employee who wouldn't leave is finally escorted out permanently, absurdly long email attachments auto-collapse, and the printer finally tells you exactly where the paper jam is. Everything is just crisp and intuitive.

title.zh-TW: 網路權限變聰明，MCP 外部工具連線更穩
title.en: Smarter network permissions and resilient MCP tools

body.zh-TW: 面對網路問題和外部權限，系統變得更有韌性。現在沙盒（sandbox）裡的網路權限只要你點過一次「允許」，整個對話期間系統都會記住，不會每次連線都跳出來煩你。對於 MCP（外部工具伺服器），如果在讀取功能清單或要求 OAuth 登入憑證時遇到網路閃斷，它現在懂得稍等一下自動重試，不會馬上宣告失敗；如果回報 404 找不到網頁，錯誤訊息也會明確列出網址並指引你檢查設定檔。此外，在無頭環境（headless，沒有螢幕或瀏覽器的環境下運行）中，系統會直接跳過叫不出瀏覽器的步驟，讓你直接貼上登入網址。在企業管控設定上，強制刷新設定（`forceRemoteSettingsRefresh`）現在會確實發送不快取的指令，保證抓到最新規則，不會被代理伺服器騙。這就像你帶人進公司大樓，以前過每個閘門警衛都要重新查一次證件，現在只要大門登記過就能暢通無阻；就算內部系統偶爾連線不穩，也會幫你自動重整幾次，不會直接把你踢出門外。
body.en: The system is now much more resilient when facing network hiccups and external permissions. Network permissions inside the sandbox now remember your 'Yes' for the remainder of the session, sparing you from annoying popups on every single connection attempt. For MCP (external tool servers), if a transient network drop occurs while fetching capability lists or requesting OAuth tokens, it now smartly waits a beat and retries instead of instantly failing. If it hits a 404 Not Found error, the message explicitly names the failing URL and points you to your config. Additionally, in headless environments (running without a display/browser), it seamlessly skips the impossible browser popup and goes straight to prompting you to paste the URL. On the enterprise management side, `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` now correctly sends a no-cache header, ensuring proxies don't feed you stale policies. It's like bringing a guest into a corporate building: instead of guards checking IDs at every single door, one sign-in at the front desk grants access for the whole visit; and if the internal intercom gets staticky, the system automatically dials again instead of throwing you out on the street.

items.original:
Fixed managed settings: `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` now takes effect when set via MDM or file policy, and the fetch sends `Cache-Control: no-cache` to prevent proxies from serving stale responses
Improved sandbox network permission dialog: hosts you allow with "Yes" are now remembered for the rest of the session instead of re-prompting on every connection
Improved MCP server reliability: capability discovery (`tools/list`, `prompts/list`, `resources/list`) now retries transient network errors with short backoff
Improved MCP OAuth: discovery and token requests now retry once after transient network errors, and headless environments skip the browser popup and go straight to the paste-the-URL prompt
Improved MCP error messages: HTTP 404 errors now show the URL and point to your MCP config

title.zh-TW: 降低 CPU 與記憶體消耗，長對話更順暢
title.en: Reduced CPU and memory drain for smoother long sessions

body.zh-TW: 長時間使用的效能大幅改善。系統現在會把生成文字的畫面更新頻率整合到每 100 毫秒一次，這樣不僅人眼看起來一樣順暢，還能大幅降低約 37% 的 CPU 佔用率。同時也減少了終端機輸出快取在長時間對話下的記憶體膨脹問題。這就像把水龍頭的噴頭從散狀改成集中水流，雖然出的水量一樣，卻能省下一大半的加壓馬達耗電，即使水開一整天也不會讓水管壓力破表。
body.en: Performance during prolonged use has been significantly optimized. The system now coalesces terminal text updates to once every 100 milliseconds while the AI is streaming—keeping the animation perfectly smooth to the human eye while slashing CPU usage by an impressive 37%. We've also addressed the terminal output cache, stopping memory from ballooning out of control during exceptionally long conversations. It's like replacing a garden hose nozzle from a frantic wide spray to a steady stream; you get the exact same amount of water exactly where you want it, but the pressure pump uses half the electricity, ensuring the pipes never burst even if left running all day.

items.original:
Reduced CPU usage during streaming responses by ~37% by coalescing text updates to 100ms
Reduced long-session memory growth from terminal output cache

title.zh-TW: 權限管控更嚴格，沙盒防護升級
title.en: Tighter permissions and upgraded sandbox security

body.zh-TW: 這次針對安全與管控做了重要升級。現在你可以透過設定 `sandbox.credentials`，防止在沙盒（sandbox，隔離的安全執行環境）裡跑的指令偷看你的密碼檔或環境變數機密。如果你在企業環境裡用，現在只要選到公司禁用的模型，介面上會明確跳出「受組織設定限制」的提示，不會讓你白忙一場。此外，對於外部工具（MCP）連線，以前如果對方毫無反應，系統會傻傻地無限期等下去；現在只要卡住 5 分鐘就會自動中斷並報錯（你也可以自己改設定），不讓整個流程被拖垮。這就像幫公司的實驗室加裝了防盜門，不但會阻擋來路不明的軟體偷拿機密資料，而且如果連線到外部廠商一直沒人接，五分鐘後電話就會自動掛斷，不會佔線一整天。
body.en: We've rolled out major upgrades for security and administrative control. You can now use the new `sandbox.credentials` setting to explicitly block commands running inside the sandbox (an isolated secure environment) from peeking at your credential files or secret environment variables. For enterprise users, the model picker now respects organization-configured restrictions and will clearly tell you if a model is "restricted by your organization's settings" rather than letting you guess why it failed. Additionally, if an external MCP tool server goes silent and hangs, the system will no longer wait around forever; it will automatically abort the call and throw an error after 5 minutes (a timeout you can adjust). It's like installing a vault door on the company lab to prevent rogue experiments from stealing passwords, and implementing a strict five-minute rule on hold times so an unresponsive vendor doesn't tie up the phone line all day.

title.zh-TW: 代理人管理更精準，不再無意義空轉
title.en: Agent management is more precise, avoiding endless spinning

body.zh-TW: 讓多個 AI 代理人（agent）一起工作時，現在更穩定了。當你要求代理人以特定格式（JSON schema）輸出結果時，它現在給出正確答案後就不會再陷入無限重覆呼叫工具的死迴圈。如果在背景工作的代理人做完事卻沒吐出結果，也不會再一直卡在「執行中」騙你。對於分支出來的子代理人，系統現在會正確計算它們的層級深度，不會讓代理人無限制地「子生孫、孫生子」下去。而且代理人被停掉時，通知現在會正確寫出是誰停的，並把用語改成更白話的「已結束」或「已停止」。如果你強制砍掉代理人，它遺留在 Git 工作樹（worktree）裡的垃圾檔案，現在系統也會自動幫你清乾淨了。這就像工廠裡的機器人，以前交差後還會原地一直轉圈圈不肯停，甚至做了一堆複製人塞滿走道，現在它們只要完成任務就會乖乖回報「停工」，而且離職時還會順手把自己的工作桌收乾淨。
body.en: Coordinating multiple AI agents is now much more stable. When you require an agent to produce structured output (like a JSON schema), it will no longer get stuck in an endless loop re-calling the output tool after already succeeding. If a background agent ends its turn without producing the requested structure, it won't deceptively stay stuck displaying a 'working' status forever. For spawned subagents, the system now accurately tracks how deep the chain goes, ensuring agents don't infinitely spawn subagents and violate the depth cap. When an agent gets halted, the notification now correctly attributes who stopped it and uses clearer wording like 'finished' or 'stopped' instead of cryptic phrasing. Also, if you kill an agent, any locked entries it left behind in your Git worktree are now automatically cleaned up. It's like factory robots that used to mindlessly spin in circles after finishing a job, or endlessly build clones of themselves until the floor ran out of space; now they properly clock out, report exactly who shut them off, and perfectly tidy up their workstations before they leave.

title.zh-TW: 介面操作大翻新，支援滑鼠點擊與全形文字
title.en: UI overhauled with mouse support and CJK text fixes

body.zh-TW: 軟體的互動體驗變得更順手了！現在如果你在全螢幕模式下叫出選單（像是模型選單 `/model` 或是權限確認），可以直接用滑鼠去點擊選項了。對於會打中文、日文、韓文等全形文字的使用者，以前在某些終端機貼上這些文字會變成一堆亂碼（mojibake），現在都修復了，會正常顯示你貼的文字。另外修復了一堆容易當機的毛病：在 Remote Control 模式下，`/update` 不會再因為卡在信任確認畫面而死當、切換代理人介面也不會再造成斷線。如果你用 VS Code 重新載入超大的對話，它也不會再把整個外掛卡死。最後，上傳檔案分享（`/share`）時，如果你中途反悔，現在按 Esc 或 Ctrl+C 終於能成功打斷上傳了。這就像原本只能用按鈕死板操作的舊型自動販賣機，現在升級成支援觸控螢幕，而且不再因為你投入外國硬幣就當機，投錯錢的時候按退幣鈕也終於有反應了。
body.en: The interactive experience has received a major polish! When running in fullscreen mode, you can now use your mouse to click on select menus directly (like the `/model` picker or permission prompts). For users of CJK (Chinese/Japanese/Korean) languages, pasting multi-byte characters in certain terminals used to result in a garbled mess of mojibake; this is fixed and your text will paste perfectly. We've also resolved a host of crash and hang bugs: running `/update` over Remote Control no longer hangs waiting for a startup trust dialog, navigating back and forth from the agents view won't spontaneously drop your connection, and the VS Code extension will no longer freeze when trying to resume an exceptionally massive session. Finally, if you change your mind while uploading a session via `/share`, hitting Esc or Ctrl+C will now successfully abort the upload. It's like an old vending machine that only took stiff button presses upgrading to a modern touchscreen; it no longer jams when you insert foreign coins, and the cancel button actually works if you change your mind mid-purchase.

title.zh-TW: 實用小功能再升級，外掛大掃除更方便
title.en: Handy feature upgrades make cleanup and setup easier

body.zh-TW: 這次還送了幾個貼心的小改進。如果你想讓 AI 幫你寫 GitHub App 的設定檔（`/install-github-app`），現在設定自動部署（workflow）已經變成選配了，你可以只裝 App 就好，不用強迫走完一整套複雜流程。使用 `/btw` 回顧歷史對話時，現在可以用左右方向鍵 `←/→` 在過往的答案中輕鬆切換。管理套件的 `/plugin` 介面變得更聰明了，它會把你好久沒用的套件挑出來放在顯眼處，提醒你可以順手清一清垃圾。而且系統在印出求救手冊（`claude --help`）時，終於記得把在背景執行的 `--bg` 參數寫進去了，不再當作隱藏秘技。這就像是你的工具箱升級了，現在買電動起子不強迫你連整組鑽頭一起買，歷史翻頁就像滑手機一樣順暢，而且抽屜會自動把長滿灰塵的舊工具推到最前面問你要不要丟掉。
body.en: We've added a handful of thoughtful quality-of-life improvements. When setting up a GitHub App (`/install-github-app`), generating the automated workflows and secrets is now completely optional, letting you install just the App itself without forcing you through a heavy CI/CD setup process. When reviewing past answers using `/btw`, you can now effortlessly step through history using the left and right `←/→` arrow keys. The plugin manager (`/plugin`) got smarter too: it now explicitly surfaces add-ons you haven't used recently, making it much easier to do some spring cleaning. Finally, when you ask for the manual (`claude --help`), it finally lists the `--bg` flag instead of keeping background mode an undocumented secret. It's like your digital toolbox got a sensible upgrade: you can now buy a power drill without being forced to buy the 100-piece bit set, flipping through history is as easy as swiping on your phone, and your drawers automatically push dusty, forgotten tools to the front so you can finally throw them out.

body.zh-TW: 使用終端機指令的體驗大升級了！現在你在終端機使用 bash 模式（打 `!` 開頭加上指令）時，Claude 不會只默默把結果記下來，而是會主動對執行結果做出回應（你如果不喜歡，也可以去設定關掉）。對於需要登入的外部工具（MCP），你現在可以直接在指令列輸入 `claude mcp login` 來登入或登出，不需要再切換到互動選單；如果你是在別台電腦透過 SSH 連線過來，還能用無瀏覽器模式完成認證。萬一你打錯了工具伺服器的名字，系統現在會聰明地猜測你是不是拼錯了，並把太長的伺服器清單縮短顯示。這就像你的助理原本只會幫你抄寫跑腿回來的發票，現在他跑完腿會順便跟你報告結果；而且現在你要進金庫，不用再跑回大廳填表，在門口直接刷卡就能進去，就連你名字寫錯一點點，門禁系統也會認得你。
body.en: The terminal command experience just got a massive upgrade! When you use bash mode (starting with `!`), Claude will no longer just silently absorb the terminal output as context; it will now proactively respond and analyze the result right away (if you prefer the old silent behavior, you can toggle it off in your settings). For external MCP tools that require authentication, you can now seamlessly log in or out directly from your shell using `claude mcp login` without being forced into an interactive menu. If you're working over an SSH connection, there's even a headless, no-browser fallback. And if you happen to typo a tool server's name, the CLI is now smart enough to suggest the closest match and cleanly truncate unwieldy lists. It's like having an assistant who used to just silently file away the receipts after running an errand, but now actively hands you a summary report; plus, you no longer have to walk all the way back to the lobby to fill out a security form to access the vault—you just swipe your card at the door, and the guard even recognizes you if you slightly misspell your own name.

title.zh-TW: 背景任務與子代理人更聽話，不再閃爍錯亂
title.en: Background tasks and subagents behave predictably without visual glitches

body.zh-TW: 子代理人與背景任務現在變得更好管教，畫面也不再亂閃了。以前在背景跑的子代理人遇到需要權限時，要嘛自己亂拒絕，要嘛卡在那邊；現在它會把權限請求丟回你的主對話框裡，並清楚標示「是哪個小助手在要權限」，你按 Esc 就能單獨拒絕那個工具。如果你派出去的小助手因為要求特定格式（JSON schema）連續五次失敗，系統現在會自動中止它，不會讓它陷入無限重試的死迴圈。我們也修好了一大堆畫面干擾：像是從代理人介面退出來時畫面不會再黏著舊紀錄、背景任務的預覽框不會再把原始的工具名稱閃爍出來、切換深淺色終端機時不再被突如其來的白光或黑畫面閃瞎，連同在主視窗按 Esc 或 Ctrl+C 時，系統現在也能正確煞車了。這就像是你派出去實習的菜鳥，以前遇到問題只會自己瞎忙或裝死，現在懂得打電話回來請示；而且他們傳回來的監視器畫面終於修好了，不會再看到殘影或莫名其妙的雪花雜訊。
body.en: Subagents and background tasks are now far more obedient and visually stable. Previously, a background subagent hitting a permissions barrier would either quietly auto-deny itself or get stuck. Now, it neatly surfaces the permission prompt back to your main session, clearly identifying which assistant is asking, and pressing Esc will cleanly deny just that specific tool. We've also added a failsafe: if an agent fails a structured JSON schema validation 5 times in a row, it now automatically aborts instead of spiraling into an infinite loop. On the visual side, we've squashed a swarm of UI glitches: closing the agents view no longer leaves ghost text painted on your screen, background task previews won't flash ugly raw tool names before loading, switching into the agents view on light terminals won't blind you with a sudden dark-theme flash, and pressing Esc or Ctrl+C in the main view while agents run in the background is now perfectly responsive. It's like managing a team of interns: they used to panic silently or spin in circles when they hit a locked door, but now they text you for permission; and the broken security monitors tracking them have finally been fixed so you no longer see weird static flashes or lingering burn-in images.

title.zh-TW: 網路與系統休眠穩健化，企業與平台連線升級
title.en: Stronger network and sleep recovery, with enterprise platform updates

body.zh-TW: 面對電腦休眠或網路環境變化，系統的防護力更強了。以前如果你在 AI 正在產生文字（streaming）時把電腦蓋上休眠，醒來後它會跳出「找不到內容」或格式解析錯誤；現在它能完美熬過這段時間，醒來繼續運作。對於企業用戶，系統現在會正確顯示按照用量計費的對話花費；如果是透過 AWS 登入的企業版，`/login` 介面也新增了「重新整理憑證」的選項，不用再等到憑證徹底過期才被踢下線。如果你使用 Chrome 擴充功能並且關掉了權限警告，多開終端機時不會再發生分頁群組無法隔離的問題。而對於帶領團隊的主代理人，現在如果開出新隊友（透過 tmux 等背景視窗），新隊友也會乖乖繼承隊長所設定的努力度（`--effort`）。此外，系統的無限重試限制最高設為 15 次，避免失控浪費。這就像你把辦公室電腦關掉睡個午覺，以前醒來資料會全毀，現在它會自己保存在雲端；而且大老闆交代專案的認真程度，現在也會準確傳達給每一個下屬，不會有人偷懶。
body.en: The system is much more resilient when your computer goes to sleep or network conditions shift. Previously, if you closed your laptop while the AI was streaming an answer, you'd wake it up to an ugly 'Content block not found' or a JSON parsing error; the system can now flawlessly survive the hibernation cycle. For Enterprise and Team users, usage-based session costs are now correctly displayed again. If you use the Claude Platform on AWS, the `/login` menu now provides a 'refresh credentials' option so you can proactively renew your token before getting kicked out. We also fixed a bug with the Chrome extension where disabling the permissions gate broke tab-group isolation when running multiple terminal sessions. In agent teams, new teammates spawned into background window panes (like tmux) will now obediently inherit the leader's designated effort level (`--effort`). Finally, we've hard-capped API retries at 15 to prevent run-away loops from burning your wallet. It's like taking a nap while a massive document is printing: you used to wake up to a jammed machine and shredded paper, but now it pauses perfectly and finishes the job when you wake up. Plus, the boss's strict instructions on how thoroughly to do the job now successfully trickle all the way down to the newest interns without anyone slacking off.

It's like reorganizing your desk: all your specialized tools now have their own dedicated drawer, you can instantly filter your in-tray, and HR will successfully process your paperwork even if you accidentally capitalized a word wrong.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式加裝防護網，攔截破壞性刪除指令
title.en: Auto mode gets safety nets against destructive commands

body.zh-TW: Claude 現在不會在你未明講放棄工作內容時執行破壞性的 Git 指令。如果你沒有明確叫它放棄目前的工作進度，系統會主動攔截那些危險的 Git 指令（像是 `git reset --hard`、`git clean -fd` 等會刪掉檔案的操作）；對於 `git commit --amend`，如果不是它自己這次對話做的提交，它也不准修改。如果你用的是 Terraform 或 Pulumi 等基礎設施工具，除非你點名要刪除特定環境，否則系統會嚴格禁止執行 `destroy` 把伺服器砍掉。此外，以前排程任務或 Webhook 收到的訊號會被系統誤當成你的鍵盤輸入，甚至不小心幫 AI 按下「同意」按鈕，現在這個安全漏洞也被補上了。這就像給除草機加裝了安全鎖，除非你明確解鎖並指著那片花圃，否則它絕對不會把珍貴的玫瑰花當成雜草一起絞掉；而且外頭飛進來的鳥也不會再誤觸開關啟動機器了。
body.en: Claude will no longer execute destructive Git commands unless you explicitly ask it to discard your local work. The system will now actively block destructive Git commands (like `git reset --hard` and `git clean -fd` that irreversibly delete files). It also refuses to run `git commit --amend` unless the agent itself made that specific commit during the current session. For infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or Pulumi, running a `destroy` command is now strictly forbidden unless you specifically name the target stack. Additionally, scheduled tasks and Webhook triggers used to be incorrectly interpreted as your keyboard inputs, sometimes accidentally 'approving' an AI action on your behalf; this dangerous loophole has been firmly closed. It's like putting a safety guard on a lawnmower: unless you explicitly flip the switch and point at a specific patch of dirt, it absolutely refuses to shred your prized rose bushes, and a stray bird landing on the handle can no longer accidentally start the engine.

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 分工合作的代理人團隊現在更可靠了。以前如果你用 tmux（一種終端機分割工具）開出新隊友，遇到電腦載入太慢就會啟動失敗，甚至你在主畫面打的字會莫名其妙跑到新隊友的視窗去，現在這些互相干擾的問題都解決了。而且，以前隊友交代給子代理人去跑的背景任務，只要隊友一結束回合就會被無情砍掉，現在任務會順利跑完。針對 AI 的搜尋與思考，以前子代理人去查網頁（WebSearch）老是查出空白結果，或是 AI 花了一大堆時間思考（thinking block）卻沒吐出任何實質對話就結束回合，現在會再提示一次模型產生可見輸出。最後，因為設定衝突導致生出子代理人時狂跳 `400 Extra inputs are not permitted` 錯誤的毛病也修好了。這就像是工廠裡的生產線，以前新來的機器人開機太慢會讓產線停擺，交代給實習生的工作也會因為主管下班就被強制丟進垃圾桶；現在大家交接順暢，就算主管下班，實習生也會把手上的工作乖乖做完。
body.en: Team-based AI collaboration just got a lot more dependable. Previously, spawning a teammate in a tmux pane (a terminal multiplexer) could fail if your shell initialization was slow, and keystrokes you typed on the main screen would bizarrely leak into the new teammate's window; these chaotic overlaps are now fixed. Also, if a teammate dispatched a background task to a subagent, that task used to be ruthlessly killed the moment the teammate finished its turn—now it survives to completion. On the cognitive side, subagents using WebSearch no longer return totally blank results, and if the AI spins its wheels generating a "thinking block" but fails to produce actual visible output, it won't just silently give up anymore—it will re-prompt the model once to produce visible output. Finally, we squashed the annoying `400 Extra inputs are not permitted` errors that plagued subagent spawns on certain configurations. It's like a busy factory floor: previously, a slow-booting new robot would jam the assembly line, and any chore handed to an intern was immediately thrown in the trash the moment their manager clocked out for the day. Now, handoffs are flawless, and the interns faithfully finish their tasks even after their boss goes home.

title.zh-TW: 設定與介面大掃除，畫面更乾淨無 Bug
title.en: Settings and UI cleaned up, squash screen-corrupting bugs

body.zh-TW: 這次的介面變得更清爽順手了。設定面板（`/config`）現在操作更直覺，你可以按 Enter 或空白鍵直接切換開關，按 Esc 也會乖乖存檔關閉，而不是像以前一樣取消還原；想知道有什麼快捷指令，也可以直接打 `/config --help` 查詢。畫面上，我們移除了每次開機都會顯示的「設定問題」警告，現在想檢查問題請直接用 `/doctor` 指令。選到已淘汰或會自動升級的模型時，現在會看到警告。針對各種當機與干擾也做了大掃除：修好了在 Windows 終端機跑大量代理人時整個畫面崩潰混亂的問題、解決了在 vim 模式下游標會卡在輸入框上面的靈異事件、拔掉了專注模式下每句話底下吵死人的 Hooks 執行計時文字，也確保你自己寫的技能不會在清單上像影分身一樣出現好幾次。最後，如果你在無頭環境（headless，沒有螢幕）需要認證 MCP 伺服器，現在也不會再因為系統亂拿假工具給 AI 用而當機了。這就像把雜亂的工作桌重新整理，不該響的警報器拔掉、壞掉的按鈕修好，連會讓螢幕閃爍的舊燈管也一併換新，讓你專心工作不被打擾。
body.en: The interface is now noticeably cleaner and more intuitive. The settings menu (`/config`) makes sense now: you can hit Enter or Space to toggle switches, and pressing Esc actually saves and closes instead of reverting all your changes. You can also run `/config --help` to easily look up shorthand keys. We've scrubbed the constant 'setup issues' nag from the startup logo; if you want a system health check, just run `/doctor`. You'll now get clear warnings if you request a deprecated model or one that automatically updates to a newer version. We also squashed a ton of screen-corrupting bugs: the total UI meltdown (merged text and duplicated spinners) in Windows Terminal under heavy subagent loads is fixed, your cursor won't get stranded above the prompt in vim mode anymore, the noisy 'PostToolUse' timing lines cluttering focus mode are gone, and user-level skills won't infinitely duplicate themselves in your autocomplete list. Finally, headless environments (running without a screen) will no longer crash by exposing fake auth-stub tools to the AI when an MCP server demands authentication. It's like thoroughly decluttering your workstation: broken buttons now work predictably, phantom alarms have been silenced, and the flickering monitor that scrambled your spreadsheets has finally been replaced, leaving you with a distraction-free space.

title.zh-TW: 三個新開關：一行改設定、放行 Apple Events、坐在電腦前不收手機推播
title.en: Three new switches: change any setting in one line, allow Apple Events, and mute phone pushes while you sit at the desk

body.zh-TW: 想隨手調設定、不想被手機打擾，現在更順手了。新增 `/config key=value` 語法，你直接在輸入框打 `/config thinking=false` 就能改任何一項設定（`thinking` 是讓 Claude 多想一步再回答的開關），不用再翻選單；互動模式、`-p` 一次性指令、Remote Control（遠端遙控，用手機控桌機的功能）都通用。macOS 多了 `sandbox.allowAppleEvents` 選項（opt-in，預設關、要你自己打開才生效的開關），打開後被沙盒（sandbox，把程式關在限制範圍裡跑的安全機制）擋住的指令才能送出 Apple Events（macOS 程式之間互相呼叫對方做事的訊息）。還有新的 `CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE` 環境變數（開程式前預先塞給它的隱藏開關），指向一個標記檔，你人在電腦前時就不會再收到手機推播，免得兩邊同時響。就像家裡總遙控器多了三顆新按鈕：按一下調亮度、按一下准許某個家電互連、人坐在沙發上就自動把臥室電視關靜音。
body.en: Tweaking settings and dodging phone buzzes is smoother now. A new `/config key=value` syntax lets you change any setting by typing it straight into the prompt — e.g. `/config thinking=false` to flip `thinking` (the switch that makes Claude reason an extra step before answering), no menu-diving required — and it works in interactive mode, `-p` one-shot commands, and Remote Control (steering the desktop app from your phone). On macOS there's a new `sandbox.allowAppleEvents` opt-in (a switch that's off by default until you turn it on); enabling it lets sandboxed commands (sandbox: the mechanism that traps a program inside a restricted zone) finally send Apple Events (messages macOS apps use to ask each other to do things). There's also a new `CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE` environment variable (a hidden switch you set before launching) that points at a marker file so mobile push notifications stay silent while you're at the machine — no more double-buzz from phone and desktop at once. Like a universal remote gaining three new buttons: tap to dim the lights, tap to let one appliance talk to another, and auto-mute the bedroom TV the moment you sit on the couch.

Added `/config key=value` syntax to set any setting from the prompt (e.g. `/config thinking=false`) — works in interactive, `-p`, and Remote Control
Added `sandbox.allowAppleEvents` opt-in setting that lets sandboxed commands send Apple Events on macOS
Added `CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE` environment variable: point it at a marker file to suppress mobile push notifications while you're at the machine

title.zh-TW: 長回覆不再一次全擠出來、斷線會自己重接，底層引擎也升級
title.en: Long replies now stream line by line, dropped connections self-retry, and the bundled engine got upgraded

body.zh-TW: 看 Claude 寫長段落的時候，文字會一行一行陸續浮現，不用再乾等第一個換行才整塊蹦出來；串流（streaming，答案一邊生成一邊逐字顯示）讀起來更順。如果它正在「思考」時連線突然斷掉，以前會直接丟一句「Connection closed while thinking」（思考時連線中斷）給你，現在會自己重試接回來，不用你手動重發。底層打包進去的 Bun 執行環境（Claude Code 跑起來所依賴的 JavaScript 引擎）也升到 1.4。就像看直播，以前訊號一斷就定格轉圈、要你手動重新整理，現在會自己接回去，而且攝影機也換了較新的一台。
body.en: When Claude writes long paragraphs, the text now trickles in line by line instead of you staring at nothing until the first line break finally triggers a whole block at once; streaming (responses appearing word by word as they generate) reads far more smoothly. And if the connection drops while it's mid-thinking, you used to get a blunt "Connection closed while thinking" message — now it automatically retries and reconnects without you having to resend anything. The bundled Bun runtime (the JavaScript engine Claude Code runs on top of) has also been upgraded to 1.4. Like watching a livestream that used to freeze and buffer every time the signal hiccuped, forcing you to hit refresh yourself — now it reconnects on its own, and the camera got swapped for a newer model too.

items.original:
Improved streaming of long paragraphs: text now appears line-by-line instead of waiting for the first line break
Improved auto-retry: API connection drops mid-thinking now automatically retry instead of showing "Connection closed while thinking"
Upgraded the bundled Bun runtime to 1.4

title.zh-TW: 子代理面板更清爽：閒置自動收起，計時不再算到別人頭上
title.en: The subagent panel is tidier: idle agents auto-hide, and timers no longer blame the wrong agent

body.zh-TW: 你派出去的子代理（subagent，Claude 再分身去辦小事的代理）一多，面板會很亂；現在閒置的子代理 30 秒後會自動隱藏，列表最多顯示 5 列並附捲動提示，底部也會顯示鍵盤快捷鍵。計時也修正了：以前子代理的「Thinking」（思考中）顯示的其實是父代理（派它出來那隻）的累計時間，現在顯示它自己的；卡在等另一隻子代理時，面板也不再一直跳秒計時，而是老實顯示「waiting」（等待中）。就像公司布告欄，以前閒置工讀生的名條一直掛著、加班時數還會算到組長頭上，現在沒事的名條自動收起、各算各的時數。
body.en: When you've spawned a pile of subagents (extra agents Claude splits off to handle small chores), the panel used to get cluttered; now idle ones auto-hide after 30 seconds, the list caps at 5 rows with scroll hints, and keyboard shortcuts appear in the footer. The timers are fixed too: a subagent's "Thinking" readout used to actually show the parent agent's (the one that spawned it) accumulated time, and now shows its own; and when a subagent is blocked waiting on a nested agent, the panel stops ticking up the seconds and honestly shows "waiting" instead. Like an office bulletin board that used to leave idle interns' name tags pinned up forever and log their overtime under the team lead — now idle tags retract on their own and everyone's hours are their own.

items.original:
Improved the subagent panel: idle subagents auto-hide after 30s, the list caps at 5 rows with scroll hints, and keyboard hints now show in the footer
Fixed subagent "Thinking" duration showing the parent agent's elapsed time instead of the subagent's own
Fixed subagents blocked on a nested agent showing a ticking elapsed time instead of "waiting" in the agent panel

title.zh-TW: 開機更利落：啟動變快、不再空白卡 15 秒、不再崩潰或凍結
title.en: Startup is snappier: faster launch, no more 15-second blank screens, no crashes or freezes

body.zh-TW: 打開 Claude Code 變快也更穩了。一個從 2.1.169 版不小心引進、每次在新環境啟動多耗約 120ms（毫秒，千分之一秒）的小延遲修掉了：沒設 MCP 伺服器（MCP server，Claude 連接外部工具的橋樑）時，第一個問題不再傻等遠端設定下載。帳號設定在爛網路下抓很慢時，以前會讓終端機空白卡到 15 秒，現在不再卡。`.claude.json`（Claude 的設定檔）裡如果混進壞掉的 null 專案紀錄，以前啟動會直接崩潰報 `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null`，現在撐得住。macOS 上 Spotlight（系統搜尋）正在重新索引時，以前工作階段一開始整個介面會凍結、連 Ctrl+C 都沒反應，現在也不會了。就像車子發動，以前冷車時要乾等、儀表板偶爾當機或亮故障燈，現在轉一下就順順發動。
body.en: Opening Claude Code is faster and steadier now. A small slowdown accidentally introduced in 2.1.169 — roughly 120ms (milliseconds, thousandths of a second) added on every launch in fresh environments — is gone: when no MCP servers (MCP server, the bridge Claude uses to plug in external tools) are configured, your first prompt no longer pointlessly waits for the remote settings fetch. When the account settings fetch is sluggish on a bad network, the terminal used to go blank and stall for up to 15 seconds; not anymore. If `.claude.json` (Claude's settings file) has corrupted null project entries in it, startup used to outright crash with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null`; it now survives. And on macOS, when Spotlight (the system-wide search) is busy reindexing, the interface used to freeze the instant a session started — even Ctrl+C went ignored — and that's fixed too. Like starting a car that used to make you wait on cold mornings and occasionally threw a dashboard error or froze; now one turn of the key and it purrs to life.

title.zh-TW: 連線狀態不再騙人：MCP 連不上會誠實說、遠端遙控不再卡「連線中」
title.en: Connection status stops lying: MCP honestly reports fetch failures, and Remote Control drops the stuck "connecting…" line

body.zh-TW: 連線到底通沒通，現在看得更清楚。`claude mcp get`／`list` 以前即使抓工具清單失敗，也會硬顯示一個綠勾「✓ Connected」（已連線）騙你；現在會誠實顯示「! Connected · tools fetch failed」（連上了、但工具抓取失敗）並附上錯誤詳情。Remote Control（遠端遙控）連上後，以前會留一行沒清掉的「connecting…」（連線中）賴著不走，現在會在紀錄裡明確確認已連上。MCP 的 OAuth（一種授權登入方式）瀏覽器頁面也改成像 Claude Code 的視覺風格，成功後還會自動關掉。就像快遞追蹤，以前顯示「已送達」但其實丟在門口找不到，現在會誠實寫「送達但簽收失敗、原因XXX」，而且寄完的網頁會自己關。
body.en: Whether a connection is actually live is now clearer. `claude mcp get` / `list` used to stubbornly flash a green "✓ Connected" tick even when fetching the tool list failed — a lie; now it honestly shows "! Connected · tools fetch failed" with the error detail attached. After Remote Control connects, it used to leave a stale "connecting…" line hanging around; it now confirms the connection explicitly in the transcript. The MCP OAuth (an authorization-login method) browser page also got restyled to match Claude Code's look and auto-closes once it succeeds. Like a package tracker that used to claim "delivered" when the parcel was actually lost on the porch — now it honestly reads "delivered but sign-off failed, reason: X," and the shipping webpage closes itself when you're done.

Fixed `claude mcp get`/`list` showing `✓ Connected` when tools/list fails; they now show `! Connected · tools fetch failed` with the error detail
Fixed `/remote-control` leaving a stale "connecting…" line; it now confirms in the transcript once connected

title.zh-TW: 憑證不再每分鐘重抓、快取讀得到、檔案不再寫成 0 byte
title.en: Credentials stop refreshing every minute, caching reads correctly, and files stop coming out 0-byte

body.zh-TW: 幾個會讓你多花時間或掉資料的連線與檔案問題修好了。AWS 的 `awsCredentialExport` 憑證（credentials，證明你是合法使用者的金鑰）如果快過期，以前會每分鐘狂刷新一次，現在也接受 `aws configure export-credentials` 吐出的 JSON 格式。自訂 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`（自己架的 API 接點）和 Foundry（企業版通道）上，prompt caching（提示詞快取，把重複內容快取起來省錢省時的機制）以前因為每輪都變的 attestation token（驗證記號）而讀不到快取，現在讀得到了。Write／Edit 寫檔到網路磁碟或雲端同步資料夾時，以前會寫出 0 byte 或被截斷的壞檔，現在正常。另外，當另一個 Claude Code 行程（process，同時跑的另一份程式）在背景跑 30 天清理時，你這邊掛很久的閒置工作階段不會再莫名丟掉歷史紀錄。就像銀行，以前存摺每分鐘被重印一次、優惠券掃不出來、轉帳偶爾變空白紀錄，現在都正常了。
body.en: Several connection and file issues that cost you time or data are fixed. AWS `awsCredentialExport` credentials (the keys proving you're a legitimate user) used to refresh frantically every minute when they neared expiry, and now also accept the JSON shape that `aws configure export-credentials` outputs. On custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` (a self-hosted API endpoint) and Foundry (an enterprise channel), prompt caching (the mechanism that caches repeated content to save money and time) used to miss the cache entirely because an attestation token (a verification marker) changed every single turn; it now reads the cache. Write/Edit writing to network drives or cloud-synced folders used to spit out 0-byte or truncated broken files; that's normal now. And when another Claude Code process (process, a second copy of the program running at the same time) runs the 30-day cleanup in the background, your long-idle sessions no longer mysteriously lose their history. Like a bank where the passbook used to get reprinted every minute, coupons wouldn't scan, and the occasional transfer came out as a blank entry — everything's normal now.

title.zh-TW: 換模型立刻生效、子代理不再無限連鎖、重試提示不再賴著不走
title.en: Model switches take effect immediately, subagents stop chaining infinitely, and the retry banner stops lingering

body.zh-TW: 切換模型跟派工的幾個邏輯修順了。你用 `/recap`（回顧對話的功能）或開分支（fork，把對話複製一份另開的動作）時，以前剛換完模型會還在用舊模型跑一輪，現在立刻用新模型。前景子代理以前會無限制地一直生出巢狀子代理（一層包一層），現在跟背景子代理一樣遵守 5 層深度上限。還有，API 重試時那行「Retrying in 0s · attempt N/10」（0 秒後重試・第 N／10 次）以前重試成功後還黏在畫面上，現在成功就消失。就像換了新廚師，以前還會讓舊廚師再炒一道才交棒；學徒以前會無限互相推工作，現在最多推五層；而且「重做中」的牌子做好菜就會拿掉，不會一直掛著。
body.en: A few model-switching and delegation logics got untangled. When you run `/recap` (the recap-the-conversation feature) or fork (copy a conversation into a new branch) right after switching models, it used to keep running on the old model for a turn; now it uses the new one immediately. Foreground subagents used to spawn nested subagents (one inside another) without limit; they now obey the same 5-level depth cap as background subagents. And the API retry banner "Retrying in 0s · attempt N/10" used to linger on screen even after the retry succeeded; it disappears now. Like switching in a new chef who'd let the old one plate one more dish before handing over, apprentices who'd bounce a task between each other forever (now capped at five bounces), and a "remaking it" sign that comes down the moment the food is done instead of staying up.

items.original:
Fixed foreground subagents spawning unbounded nested chains; they now respect the same 5-level depth limit as background subagents
Fixed `/recap` and conversation forks using the previous model immediately after a model switch
Fixed the API retry indicator ("Retrying in 0s · attempt N/10") staying on screen after the retry succeeded

title.zh-TW: macOS 授權、Windows、符號連結設定檔都不再出錯
title.en: macOS auth, Windows, and symlinked settings files all stop erroring out

body.zh-TW: 不同平台跟特殊設定下的幾個地雷拆掉了。macOS 上用 `open`、`osascript` 或瀏覽器登入的授權流程（auth flow，登入拿權限的一連串步驟）以前會失敗並報 error -600，原因是少了 Apple Events entitlement（蘋果允許程式互相呼叫的正式許可），現在補上了。Windows 上 ExitWorktree（退出工作樹的功能）以前因為找不到純 `git` 指令、會用「Could not verify worktree state」拒絕刪掉乾淨的工作樹（worktree，同一專案多開平行副本的 Git 功能），現在能正常移除。當 `~/.claude/settings.json` 是放在另一個符號連結（symlink，像捷徑一樣指向別處的檔案）底下的相對符號連結時，`/effort`、`/model` 這類設定變更以前會報 ENOENT（找不到檔案的錯誤），現在正常。Windows／OneDrive 上 agents 目錄（放自訂代理的資料夾）已存在時，建立代理以前會報「EEXIST: file already exists」，現在也能建立。就像裝潢，以前某幾種牆面釘釘子就整面報錯，現在不管實牆、隔間板、還是已經有釘孔的牆都能正常施工。
body.en: Several landmines on different platforms and unusual setups are cleared. On macOS, auth flows (the sequence of login steps that grant permissions) using `open`, `osascript`, or a browser used to fail with error -600 because of a missing Apple Events entitlement (Apple's formal permission for apps to call each other); it's now been added. On Windows, ExitWorktree (the leave-a-worktree feature) used to refuse removing a clean worktree (worktree, the Git feature that spins up parallel copies of one project) with "Could not verify worktree state" because bare `git` couldn't be resolved; it now removes them properly. When `~/.claude/settings.json` is a relative symlink living under another symlink (symlink, a file that points elsewhere like a shortcut), setting changes like `/effort` or `/model` used to throw ENOENT (a file-not-found error); they work now. And on Windows/OneDrive, when the agents directory (the folder holding your custom agents) already existed, creating an agent used to throw "EEXIST: file already exists"; it creates fine now. Like home renovation where certain wall types used to throw a blanket error the moment you drove in a nail — now solid walls, partition boards, and walls that already have holes all take nails without complaint.

items.original:
Fixed `open`, `osascript`, and browser-based auth flows failing with error -600 on macOS by adding the Apple Events entitlement
Fixed ExitWorktree refusing to remove a clean worktree with "Could not verify worktree state" when bare `git` cannot be resolved on Windows
Fixed settings changes (such as `/effort` or `/model`) failing with ENOENT when `~/.claude/settings.json` is a relative symlink under a symlinked `~/.claude`
Fixed agent creation failing with "EEXIST: file already exists" when the agents directory already exists (Windows/OneDrive)

title.zh-TW: 複製貼上不再出包：Ctrl+C 不覆蓋剪貼簿、Ctrl+V 文字貼得出、Linux 也能複製
title.en: Copy/paste stops misbehaving: Ctrl+C won't clobber the clipboard, Ctrl+V pastes text, and Linux copy works

body.zh-TW: 剪貼簿（clipboard，系統暫存你要複製內容的地方）三個毛病修好了。全螢幕模式下，如果你先用滑鼠加了修飾鍵拖曳（modifier+drag，像按著某鍵再拉選）選了一段終端機原生選取範圍，再按 Ctrl+C，以前會把你應用程式裡舊的選取內容蓋進剪貼簿，現在不會。Ctrl+V 在剪貼簿裡是文字時，以前會顯示「No image found in clipboard」（剪貼簿找不到圖片）而不貼上，現在會正常貼上文字。Linux 上 `/copy` 和選取即複製（copy-on-select）以前偵測不到「Claude Code 啟動後才裝的」剪貼簿工具，現在能偵測到了。就像影印機，以前按複製會把上一份蓋掉你的、放純文字卻堅持要找圖片、而且新裝的紙匣它認不得，現在都正常了。
body.en: Three clipboard (the place the system parks what you copy) bugs are fixed. In fullscreen, if you first made a native-terminal selection by modifier+drag (dragging while holding a key) and then hit Ctrl+C, it used to overwrite the clipboard with the app's prior selection; it no longer does. Ctrl+V, when the clipboard held text, used to show "No image found in clipboard" and refuse to paste; it now pastes the text normally. And on Linux, `/copy` and copy-on-select (copy the moment you select) used to fail to detect a clipboard utility that was installed after Claude Code started; they detect it now. Like a photocopier that used to copy over your originals with the previous job, refused anything but images when you fed it plain text, and didn't recognize a freshly installed paper tray — all working now.

items.original:
Fixed Ctrl+C in fullscreen after a native terminal selection (modifier+drag) overwriting the clipboard with the app's prior selection
Fixed Ctrl+V showing "No image found in clipboard" instead of pasting when the clipboard contains text
Fixed `/copy` and copy-on-select on Linux not detecting a clipboard utility installed after Claude Code started

title.zh-TW: 一批畫面細節修順：行號、縮排預覽、問卷對話框、日期、跑馬燈都對齊
title.en: A batch of display polish: line numbers, indent previews, dialog boxes, dates, and the spinner all line up

body.zh-TW: 一堆影響閱讀的小顯示問題修好了。IDE（編輯器外掛，像 IntelliJ、VS Code）選取的行號在提醒訊息裡以前會差一，現在準了。Write 建檔預覽裡用 Tab 縮排的程式碼以前縮排顯示錯誤，現在正確。AskUserQuestion（Claude 反過來問你問題的功能）的預覽內容以前會在對話框邊緣被截斷，現在會自動折行；多選題裡你手打的「Other」（其他）自由作答以前送出會被默默丟掉，現在保留。`/stats`（統計功能）的「Most active day」（最活躍那天）和每日 token（用量計量單位）圖表在 UTC 負時區（比世界標準時間慢的地區，如美洲）以前會早一天，現在準了。全螢幕下要開網址現在得 Cmd+click（macOS）／Ctrl+click，跟原生終端機一致。`Improved N memories`（更新了幾則記憶）那行在非詳細模式下不再逐字列出檔名。排隊等你這輪結束的輸入訊息現在會顯示整條背景高亮。Ghostty（一款終端機軟體）上轉圈動畫的脈衝以前會停在錯誤的字元大小，現在正常。就像一份排版粗糙的報告，行號錯一格、表格超出邊界、日期早一天、連載入動畫都忽大忽小，現在全部對齊了。
body.en: A pile of small readability-affecting display issues are fixed. The line numbers from your IDE (editor plugin, like IntelliJ or VS Code) selection used to be off by one in context reminders; they're accurate now. Tab-indented code in the Write create-file preview used to render with wrong indentation; it's correct now. AskUserQuestion (the feature where Claude asks you back) preview content used to get cut off at the dialog edge; it now word-wraps, and a typed "Other" free-text answer in a multi-select question used to be silently dropped on submit; it's now preserved. `/stats` "Most active day" and the daily token (a usage unit) chart used to show one day early in UTC-negative timezones (regions behind world-standard time, like the Americas); they're accurate now. Opening a URL in fullscreen now requires Cmd+click (macOS) / Ctrl+click, matching native terminals. The `Improved N memories` line no longer lists individual files outside verbose mode. Input messages queued until your turn ends now get a full-width background highlight. And on Ghostty (a terminal app), the activity spinner's pulse used to dwell on the wrong glyph size; it's normal now. Like a sloppily laid-out report where the line numbers were one off, tables spilled past the margin, dates were a day early, and even the loading animation flickered in size — now everything lines up.

items.original:
Changed fullscreen mode URL opening to require Cmd+click (macOS) / Ctrl+click, matching native terminal behavior
Changed the `Improved N memories` line to no longer list individual files outside verbose mode
Fixed IDE selection line numbers in context reminders being off by one (IntelliJ and VS Code)
Fixed AskUserQuestion preview content being cut off at the dialog edge instead of word-wrapping
Fixed AskUserQuestion multi-select questions silently dropping a typed "Other" free-text answer when submitting
Fixed `/stats` "Most active day" and daily token chart dates showing one day early in UTC-negative timezones
Fixed tab-indented code rendering with incorrect indentation in the Write (create-file) preview
Fixed user prompts queued mid-turn not showing a full-width background highlight in the transcript
Fixed the activity spinner's pulse dwelling on the wrong glyph size in Ghostty
